verdict: CLOSE THE MASSIVE ORDERED-Q3 TANGENT SPECTRUM, ITS EXACT NESTED SPECTRAL GAUSSIAN STATE FAMILY, ITS STANDARD MASSIVE HADAMARD COMPARATOR, AND FIXED-MODE O(a^2) CONVERGENCE OF THE CENTERED CL8 TANGENT; FORMALLY REJECT NATURAL EXACT CENTERED PROJECTIVITY AND A NORMAL CRITICAL COMPACT GAUSSIAN GROUND; RETAIN THE INTERACTING HISTORY-CUT, LOOP-PROTECTION, 3D, PHYSICAL, C6, CP1, AND PRE-A GATES
statement: For r<0, the actual Q3-locked ordered wells have eight exactly diagonal Walsh species branches with stiffness nu_s=-2r(1+s*lambda/g), of multiplicities 1,3,3,1. The inherited a/8 symplectic weight fixes the normalized Fourier canonical variables and the centered-lattice quadratic frequencies omega_(a,n,s)^2=[nu_s+c*khat_a(n)^2]/chi. A separate continuum-symbol spectral cutoff gives an exactly projective family of regular quasi-free ground states on nested finite-mode Weyl algebras; its direct-limit state is the standard eight-component massive ground state on the inserted flat 1+1 cylinder and is Hadamard by the established static-ground theorem. The inherited centered-lattice Gaussian tangents are not exactly projective under the natural identity of shared normalized Fourier generators, but every fixed finite mode set and finite-time two-point matrix converges to that comparator at O(a^2). As r approaches zero from below, all bare masses collapse with mean-field tangent exponents nu_MF=1/2 and z=1 and all nonzero continuum branches share v_bare=sqrt(c/chi); this equality comes from the inserted common principal coefficients and has no loop or regulator protection theorem. At r=0 the compact spatial zero mode is a free particle, so the full quadratic tangent has no normalizable Gaussian ground and the massive ground covariances have no regular full-field limit. None of these quadratic statements establishes a thermodynamic or quantum phase transition, the interacting continuum state, physical light, or Pre-A.

model_scope.selected_model: the inserted one-dimensional per-unit-transverse-area CL8/Q3LOCK ordered-well quadratic tangent on a periodic circle of fixed circumference L
model_scope.parameter_domain: L,chi,c,g,hbar positive; lambda nonnegative; r<0 for the massive state theorem; M even for the centered periodic regulator
model_scope.ordered_background: q_(j,e)=sigma*v with sigma=plus or minus one and v^2=-r/g; lambda>0 leaves exactly these two global classical wells, while lambda=0 has additional sign wells but the displayed common-sign Hessian remains valid
model_scope.inserted_data: the one-dimensional reduction, circle, time coordinate, hbar, ground-state criterion, common kinetic coefficients, and the interpretation of any characteristic or horizon remain inputs
model_scope.quadratic_only: the state is the ground state of the Hessian Hamiltonian around one chosen ordered well, not the exact interacting finite-volume ground or Gibbs state

ordered_Q3_hessian.Walsh_basis: chi_alpha(e)=(-1)^(alpha dot e), with alpha in {0,1}^3 and s=|alpha|
ordered_Q3_hessian.cube_spectrum: L_Q3 chi_alpha=2s chi_alpha, with multiplicities 1,3,3,1 for s=0,1,2,3
ordered_Q3_hessian.factor_audit: one locked edge contributes lambda*v^2*(delta q_e-delta q_f)^2/2 to the quadratic energy; the factor 2 in nu_s comes from the Q3 Laplacian eigenvalue 2s

canonical_mode_normalization.unweighted_transform: y_(n,alpha)=(8M)^(-1/2) sum_(j,e) exp(-i*k_n*x_j) chi_alpha(e) delta q_(j,e), with the same orthogonal transform for p
canonical_mode_normalization.CCR: for I_M={-M/2,...,M/2-1} with indices modulo M, [Phi_(n,alpha),P_(m,beta)]=i*hbar*delta_(alpha,beta)*delta^(M)_(n+m,0); reality pairs n and -n, while n=-M/2 is self-conjugate

spectral_projective_state_family.real_mode_space: V_K is the finite real symplectic direct sum of the n=0 cosine coordinate and the cosine/sine coordinates for 1<=n<=K, for every Q3 Walsh species
spectral_projective_state_family.state: for W(f,g)=exp[i*sum(f*P-g*Phi)/hbar], omega_K(W(f,g))=exp[-sum(chi*omega_0*f^2+g^2/(chi*omega_0))/(4hbar)]; equivalently each real oscillator has C_Phi=hbar/(2chi*omega_0), C_P=hbar*chi*omega_0/2 and zero symmetrized cross covariance
spectral_projective_state_family.typed_embedding: iota_(K,K_prime):W(V_K)->W(V_K_prime) pads every absent real Fourier coordinate by zero and is symplectic
spectral_projective_state_family.projective_identity: omega_(K_prime) composed with iota_(K,K_prime)=omega_K for K_prime>=K; this is a state restriction identity, not an untyped density-matrix partial trace
spectral_projective_state_family.direct_limit: the compatible characteristic functionals define the standard regular quasi-free massive ground state on the finite-Fourier test-function union
spectral_projective_state_family.regulator_boundary: this spectral cutoff uses the continuum symbol k_n^2 and is not the inherited centered nodal CL8 regulator

Hadamard_comparator.result: for r<0, the direct-limit state is the direct sum of eight massive static Klein-Gordon ground states on the smooth flat cylinder and therefore has the Hadamard singularity structure
Hadamard_comparator.effective_geometry: ds^2=-dt^2+(chi/c)dx^2, proper circumference sqrt(chi/c)*L, standard field phi=(chi*c)^(1/4)*Phi, and mass_s^2=nu_s/chi
Hadamard_comparator.full_Cauchy_extension: on smooth Cauchy data the Fourier coefficients decay rapidly, while omega_n grows linearly and its inverse is mass-bounded; the covariance forms therefore extend continuously from finite Fourier labels to the full smooth-data CCR algebra
Hadamard_comparator.spacetime_two_point: W_s(t,x;t_prime,x_prime)=hbar/(2*chi*L) sum_n exp[-i*omega_(n,s)*(t-t_prime)+i*k_n*(x-x_prime)]/omega_(n,s), as a distribution; every spectral cutoff state is its exact finite-mode restriction
Hadamard_comparator.theorem_owner: Fulling, Narcowich and Wald, Annals of Physics 136 (1981), DOI 10.1016/0003-4916(81)90098-1; also Junker, arXiv:hep-th/9507097
Hadamard_comparator.repository_contribution: the exact Q3 mass matrix, a/8 canonical normalization, and identification of the spectral projective state with the hypotheses of the established static-ground theorem
Hadamard_comparator.scope_boundary: this certifies a free massive ordered-tangent comparator only; it is not a Hadamard theorem for the interacting CL8 state, nonlinear history-cut state, critical zero-mode theory, or a 3+1 spacetime

centered_fixed_mode_limit.characteristic_limit: on every fixed finite set of real modes, the centered Gaussian characteristic functions converge at O(a^2) for each fixed Weyl label, uniformly on bounded label subsets; this yields weak-star convergence on that fixed finite-mode Weyl algebra
centered_fixed_mode_limit.finite_time_limit: on every fixed finite mode set and compact time-difference interval, the positive-frequency two-point matrices converge at O(a^2)
centered_fixed_mode_limit.nonuniformities: the bounds are not uniform through r=0, over modes growing with the cutoff, in total vacuum energy, or for the nonlinear interacting state

centered_projectivity_no_go.target: exact equality of centered-difference ordered-tangent Gaussian ground states under the natural identity of shared normalized Fourier field and momentum generators
centered_projectivity_no_go.witness_domain: every shared nonzero non-Nyquist mode 0<|n|<M/2 when c>0
centered_projectivity_no_go.exact_fixture: L=6, M=6, n=2 gives khat_a^2=3; the M=12 refinement gives khat_(a/2)^2=4
centered_projectivity_no_go.conclusion: the refined field covariance is strictly smaller and its momentum covariance strictly larger, so omega_(a/2) composed with the natural shared-mode inclusion is not omega_a
centered_projectivity_no_go.survivors: O(a^2) fixed-mode convergence, the exact spectral family, mode-dependent symplectic squeezes, symbol-matched or perfect actions, counterterms, and interacting renormalized limits are not excluded

critical_zero_mode_no_go.target: a normalizable regular Gaussian ground state of the full r=0 periodic quadratic tangent including its spatial zero coordinates
critical_zero_mode_no_go.mass_collapse: nu_s=-2r*(1+s*lambda/g) tends to zero for all eight Walsh species as r increases to zero from below
critical_zero_mode_no_go.zero_mode_Hamiltonian: at r=0 and n=0, each tangent branch is H=P^2/(2chi), the quantum-mechanical free particle on R
critical_zero_mode_no_go.covariance_witness: C_Phi=hbar/(2*sqrt(chi*nu_s)) diverges and C_P tends to zero; the limiting Weyl characteristic function is discontinuous in any nonzero zero-mode field direction
critical_zero_mode_no_go.conclusion: the full compact quadratic tangent has no normalizable ground vector and the massive Gaussian family has no regular full-field ground-state limit at criticality
critical_zero_mode_no_go.survivors: the exact interacting finite-volume quartic ground, non-ground or squeezed zero-mode prescriptions, decompactification, constraints, compact target fields, and a deliberately reduced mean-zero algebra are not excluded

bare_critical_scaling_and_speed.correlation_length: xi_s=sqrt(c/nu_s), so xi_s is proportional to (-r)^(-1/2) and the bare Gaussian correlation-length exponent is nu_MF=1/2
bare_critical_scaling_and_speed.dynamic_exponent: Delta_s is proportional to xi_s^(-1), hence the bare tangent exponent is z=1
bare_critical_scaling_and_speed.common_speed: v_bare=sqrt(c/chi); at r=0 and nonzero continuum k, omega_s(k)=v_bare*|k| for every species
bare_critical_scaling_and_speed.finite_lattice_warning: at r=0, d omega_a/dk=v_bare*cos(k*a/2) on the positive Brillouin branch, so the finite centered lattice does not have a constant group velocity at all k
bare_critical_scaling_and_speed.protection_boundary: the equality follows from the declared species-independent principal gradient and inertia matrices. Q3 symmetry by itself permits additional Q3-invariant derivative operators, and no loop, RG, regulator, Lorentz, or physical-light protection theorem is proved
